ticket.subject: Cannot access account after password change
ticket.description: I changed my password this morning and now I cannot login with the new password. The old password doesn't work either. I keep getting invalid credentials error messages.

ticket.subject: Duplicate charges on credit card statement
ticket.description: I have multiple duplicate charges on my credit card for the same subscription. The charges appeared on July 3rd and 4th totaling $99.98. I should only have been charged $49.99 once.

ticket.subject: Feature request: notifications API
ticket.description: We would like a notifications API that allows us to send notifications to users programmatically. This would enable more integrated user experiences across our applications.

ticket.subject: Application crashes when creating large documents
ticket.description: Every time I try to create a document with more than 500 pages the application crashes to desktop. I get a memory error that suggests the application is leaking memory during document creation.

ticket.subject: Two-factor authentication code not accepted
ticket.description: I'm trying to login with 2FA enabled but the authentication codes generated by my authenticator app are constantly rejected as invalid. I've synchronized the app and tried multiple times.

ticket.subject: API returns inconsistent data across calls
ticket.description: The same API endpoint returns different data when called multiple times with identical parameters. This inconsistency is breaking our caching strategy and causing issues in our application.

ticket.subject: Cannot access account from geographic location
ticket.description: My account is blocked from my new office location. The system shows unusual activity detection but I'm using my authorized devices. I cannot access my work data from this location.

ticket.subject: Refund pending for several weeks
ticket.description: I requested a refund on June 15th and was told it would be processed within 5 business days. It's now been almost a month and I still haven't seen the refund on my credit card statement.

ticket.subject: Search feature returns null results for known items
ticket.description: I can see items in the system but searching for them returns no results. The search seems to be broken for certain types of items. Manual browsing works but search is completely unreliable.

ticket.subject: Feature request: real-time collaboration tools
ticket.description: Our team would benefit greatly from real-time collaborative editing and commenting features. Multiple team members need to work on the same document simultaneously without versioning issues.

ticket.subject: Session expires unexpectedly during work
ticket.description: My session keeps getting terminated in the middle of my work. I'll be working and suddenly get logged out with no warning. The timeout setting is 2 hours but this happens within 30 minutes.

ticket.subject: Cannot invite new team members
ticket.description: When I try to invite new team members the email notifications never arrive. I can see the invitations in the system marked as sent but the recipients never receive them.

ticket.subject: Invoice shows incorrect company name
ticket.description: The invoice I received shows the wrong company name. I need invoices with our correct legal company name for accounting and tax purposes. Can this be corrected going forward?

ticket.subject: Feature request: advanced scheduling capabilities
ticket.description: We need more sophisticated scheduling options including recurring schedules with complex rules. Our current workflow requires scheduling tasks on specific days with exclusions for holidays.

ticket.subject: Mobile app loses data on configuration change
ticket.description: When I change device orientation the app loses unsaved data and resets to the home screen. This is frustrating as I lose my work whenever I rotate my device accidentally.

ticket.subject: Rate limiting prevents legitimate API usage
ticket.description: Our legitimate application keeps hitting rate limits even though our usage patterns should be well within acceptable bounds. We need higher rate limits or a whitelist for our API calls.

ticket.subject: Cannot update profile information
ticket.description: When I try to edit my profile information and click save nothing happens. The changes don't persist and I always see the old information. This has been happening for a week.

ticket.subject: Feature request: custom report builder
ticket.description: We need the ability to build custom reports with flexible field selection and aggregation options. Our reporting needs don't fit the standard report templates provided.

ticket.subject: Exported data missing critical fields
ticket.description: When I export data as CSV some critical fields are not included in the export file. I can see these fields in the web interface but they're missing from exported data. I need complete exports.

ticket.subject: Feature request: dark mode for web application
ticket.description: Please implement a dark mode option for the web application. We work during evening hours and the bright interface causes significant eye strain. A dark theme would greatly improve usability.

ticket.subject: Premium features not accessible despite paid plan
ticket.description: I upgraded to a premium plan 10 days ago but premium features are still locked. I can see in the system that my plan is set to premium but the features are not available in the interface.

ticket.subject: Feature request: integration with payment gateways
ticket.description: We would like the platform to integrate with popular payment gateways like Stripe and PayPal. This would streamline our billing process and reduce manual work significantly.

ticket.subject: Notification preferences not being respected
ticket.description: I've turned off all notifications but I'm still receiving constant email alerts. My notification settings seem to have no effect on what emails are sent to me.

ticket.subject: Feature request: version control and history
ticket.description: We need the ability to track changes and maintain version history for all documents. Rolling back to previous versions would be essential for managing our document lifecycle.

ticket.subject: Cannot generate API keys for integration
ticket.description: The API key generation page shows an error when I try to create new keys. The button appears to hang and nothing happens. I need these keys to connect my application.

ticket.subject: Incorrect billing period on invoice
ticket.description: The billing period shown on my invoice doesn't match when I was actually charged. It shows June 15 to July 15 but I was charged on July 1st. The dates are inconsistent.

ticket.subject: Feature request: conditional logic in workflows
ticket.description: Our workflows need conditional branching based on data values. If-then-else logic would allow us to create more sophisticated automation without external tools.

ticket.subject: Login page stuck on loading screen
ticket.description: The login page on mobile keeps showing a loading spinner indefinitely. I can access the login page on desktop but mobile version is completely broken. I cannot access my account from my phone.

ticket.subject: Feature request: advanced filtering and sorting options
ticket.description: We need more sophisticated filtering with multi-level sorting and saved filter presets. Current filtering is too basic for managing our large datasets effectively.

ticket.subject: Cross-browser compatibility issues with application
ticket.description: The application works fine in Chrome but has layout issues in Firefox and Safari. Buttons are misaligned and some features don't work properly in these browsers. We need better cross-browser support.
